newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh call rates close higher.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh call rates close higher.

text.p: Bangladesh call money rates ended higher at 6.0 percent to 8.0 percent against the previous closing at 5.5-6.5 percent, dealers said.
Dealers said the call rates opened at 6.0-8.0 percent and remained unchanged in a steady session. "The rates are unlikely to go up further. It will rather ease," said one dealer with a foreign bank.
Call rates soared Wednesday from 4.0-4.75 percent as the liquidity position of the banks strained after they bought 4.0 billion taka worth of Bangladesh (central) Bank bills.
